configuration.policy: claimable draws automatically claimed; capped games unadjudicated

naive.method: Wilson on fractional game scores (ignores pair dependence)

paired.method: pentanomial over opening pairs; normal interval on the pair mean
paired.elo_ci95_note: all pairs scored identically: the sample gives no variance information, so no interval is reported

opening_clustered.method: opening-clustered (CR1) variance of the pair mean with a Student-t interval on G-1 degrees of freedom
opening_clustered.elo_ci95_note: zero variance across openings: no interval reported
